$comment: Game feel for the Phaser layer (input gestures, pan, juice, HUD). Not part of the sim bundle or contentHash: nothing here changes a hunt's outcome (D-019). Times in ms, distances in design px, pan speeds in camera reference units per second.

quality.$comment: QualityManager tiers (Settings → quality; auto picks lowTierMaxCores-or-fewer coarse-pointer devices as low, else medium). Tiers only cut cost (particles), never what the player can see: secret glints show on every tier. M9 adds a benchmark.

accessibility.$comment: Settings → reduce flashes: muzzle flash and hint glint alpha; the belt's red empty-click flash is off. Large flashes are capped at 3/s regardless (GDD §18.3).

ftue.$comment: Oupa se Les presentation (GDD §16): when the windpomp hint shows (fraction of the hunt), how long a step banner stays, and the longest prompt allowed (characters, one line).
